_doc.purpose: Grandfather list for scripts/check-dir-size.mjs, which enforces the <=80-non-test-files-per-directory target from ADR-0001. JSON has no comments, so the documentation is this key.
_doc.counting: Tracked files sitting directly in a directory, tests excluded. Scope is src/ and extensions/*/src. A directory's subtree does not count against it — subdirectories are the relief valve, not a workaround.
_doc.max: The count each directory was at when it was grandfathered. It is a ratchet: growing past max fails, dropping below it warns so the max can be tightened, and reaching the limit makes the entry prunable.
_doc.status: Two entries are permanent by ADR. The other ten are the remaining sub-grouping work, and this list is the metric for it: it shrinks as phase-3-style splits land.

src/plugin-sdk.reason: Permanent, per docs/adr/0003-plugin-sdk-stays-flat.md: the flat directory IS the published export namespace — one file, one openclaw/plugin-sdk/<name> subpath, mirrored by 320 package.json export entries and the tsconfig wildcard.

src/agents.reason: Permanent, per docs/adr/0004-agents-is-the-application-layer.md: agents is the application layer, not a peer domain, and its size is a property of that. Navigation comes from its 27 sub-directories.

src/agents/tools.reason: Remaining sub-grouping work; the largest agents sub-group.

src/shared.reason: Accepted per docs/adr/0005-shared-is-the-helper-home.md: the src/utils fold grew it past the target, with topical sub-directories as the relief valve.

extensions/slack/src.reason: Remaining sub-grouping work; the only extension over the limit.
